welcome.betaTextPrefix: Before HoopConnect reaches thousands of players —
welcome.betaTextSuffix: . You're part of an elite group of early users shaping this app. Your feedback changes the game — literally.
welcome.discordText: We have a Discord server — chat with other players, show up to events with us, and help us build HoopConnect.

step0.title:
What's
your name?
step0.sub: NBA coaches know every player's name. Let's start the same way.
step0.greetingSub: Good call being here. Let's get started.

step1.title:
When were
you born?
step1.sub: Age decides the intensity and type of training. We have a special program for every stage.

descs.foundations: We focus on technique and fun. Priority: fundamentals and love for the game.
descs.development: Time to build the engine. Technique + athleticism + early tactics.
descs.intensification: College recruiting window is open. Intensity rises, recovery is key.
descs.advanced: A serious program. You train like a pro — with pro discipline.

step2.title:
How many
days a week?
step2.sub: More isn't always better. Recovery is part of training — without it, you don't grow.

days.label: 6 DAYS
days.sub: Pro · Only if you sleep 9h and eat well

step3.title:
Where are
you from?
step3.sub: Helps us show matches and teams near you, even without GPS.
step3.citySubSuffix: will show up right away when GPS isn't available.
